about: Phase 25a regression baseline: per-case PASS/FAIL of the investigation eval with the FAKE models (CI's routing.test.yaml), i.e. the CODE path (rubric order). CI fails when a case that passed here fails. A fix that makes a FAIL pass is not an error: update this file in the same PR. Not an accuracy claim: 16 synthetic scenarios written for this eval (an upper bound). Phase 25 (flaw (c)): wrong_high per case = a HIGH claim that is not the planted cause; CI also fails when a case without one gains one.
